e-webhooks.1.evidence: Browser, admin 1440: Settings > Webhooks > Add Webhook with URL https://example.com/jetonomy-qa-rft (the line's hooks.example.test does not resolve) and events post.created + reply.created -> 'Webhook saved.'; list row shows URL, event labels, Active, last triggered and failures; the signing secret is shown on the Edit screen (not in the list or the API list). The row URL was then pointed at a loopback address so no real delivery could leave the site

e-webhooks.2.evidence: Browser: malformed URL 'not a url' -> 'Enter a valid webhook URL. The webhook was not saved.'; valid URL with no events ticked -> 'Choose at least one event. A webhook with no events would never fire, so it was not saved.'

e-webhooks.3.evidence: admin POST /webhooks: ftp://x -> 400 jetonomy_webhook_url_invalid 'Invalid webhook URL.'; events ["bogus"] on a valid host -> 400 jetonomy_webhook_events_invalid 'At least one valid event is required.'; http://127.0.0.1 and http://10.0.0.5 refused at create with 400 'Invalid webhook URL.'; a row that already holds a loopback URL (inserted for the walk) is not fetched at delivery: the delivery is logged status 0 'A valid URL was not provided.'

e-webhooks.4.evidence: POST /webhooks/{id}/test on a loopback row returns success:false status_code 0 'A valid URL was not provided.' without fetching; the signed payload and a 200/500 receiver need a public request catcher, which this stack does not have (creating one on a third-party service was refused by the permission system)

e-webhooks.5.evidence: Event firing observed: qa_rft_w4_d published a General Discussion topic -> one queued jetonomy_pro_dispatch_webhook job with event post.created and payload {id,title,author_id=253,space_id,created_at}; the X-Jetonomy-Signature / X-Jetonomy-Event headers reaching a receiver need a public request catcher (not available here)

e-webhooks.6.evidence: Queue observation: edit -> exactly one post.updated job, delete -> one post.deleted {id,space_id,user_id}, reply -> one reply.created; no duplicates per action (webhook subscribed to the events). Delivery to a receiver itself not observed

e-webhooks.7.evidence: Space with require_approval: topic by d is held pending and no job is queued; after the admin approves it exactly one post.created job appears; a draft topic queues nothing

e-webhooks.8.evidence: is_private topic -> no job. Recorded: an admin topic in Customer Advisory Board (private space) DOES queue post.created with its title, so private-space titles leave the site to the configured URL

e-webhooks.9.evidence: Anonymous topic (anonymity-on space, author qa_rft_w4_e) -> queued post.created payload author_id 0

e-webhooks.10.evidence: Failure half observed: with deliveries failing (status 0) fail_count climbed to 16 and the webhook went is_active 0 after 5; admin list shows 'Disabled', '1 minute ago (0)' (last status code) and Failures 16. The 'one later success resets fail_count to 0' half needs a receiver that answers 200 - not available

e-webhooks.11.evidence: GET /webhooks/{id}/deliveries returns event, status_code, response, created_at, 20 per page (100 with a limit parameter); the daily prune hook deleted a 40-day-old row. The 500-character cap on the stored response needs a receiver that returns a large body (code truncates with mb_substr 500, not observed)

e-webhooks.12.evidence: PATCH /webhooks/99999 -> 404 jetonomy_webhook_not_found 'Webhook not found.'; DELETE removes the row and a later topic queues no job

e-webhooks.13.evidence: qa_rft_w4_a (member) and test_moderator: GET, POST, /test all 403 jetonomy_forbidden; guest 401 rest_not_logged_in; admin list responses carry no secret field

e-webhooks.14.evidence: Queued payloads observed: user.registered {id,login,email,registered}, user.trust_level_changed {user_id,old_level 0,new_level 2} (admin trust-level endpoint), space.member_joined {space_id,user_id,role}, space.member_left {space_id,user_id}

e-webhooks.15.evidence: With 20 webhooks and 5,016 delivery rows the Webhooks tab loads in 0.34 s (all 20 rows, no pager - the hook list is not paginated); deliveries REST paginates (20 default). 'Last triggered' is a relative time ('1 minute ago'), so no absolute site-timezone date to check (site timezone flipped to Asia/Kolkata and back to confirm nothing else changes)

e-webhooks.16.evidence: A receiver slower than 15 s needs a real slow endpoint; the dispatch is an async Action Scheduler job (the member's post returned immediately in every test above), but the 15 s timeout and status 0 with the error need a reachable receiver

e-webhooks.17.evidence: Browser 390: form and list stay inside the viewport (scrollWidth 390, tables 366 px in 366 px wrappers, list wrapper overflow-x auto); events checkboxes at x 31-56; no secret on the list
